description: This bar chart illustrates the number of datasets originating from different countries over the years 2012 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents “Year,” with labels ranging from 2012 to 2022 in sequential order. The vertical axis represents “Number of datasets,” labeled with a logarithmic scale ranging from 1 to 10<sup>2</sup>, with tick labels at 1, 10, and 100.  The chart consists of grouped bars for each year, with each group representing the number of datasets from a specific country: UK (blue), USA (orange), IN (green), IT (purple), DE (brown), and Other (grey). In 2012, the UK has a bar of approximately 1, while Other has a bar of approximately 0.1. In 2022, the UK has the tallest bar at approximately 80, while DE has the shortest bar at approximately 2. The bars are grouped by year and country, with each country represented by a different color as indicated in the legend. The bars are arranged in chronological order from 2012 to 2022, and no bars are visually emphasized.
